prompt:

Create ONE finished landscape 1536x1024 comic panel, NOT a character sheet. Alien civilization world, grey-purple ruins, ochre sand, stone cairns. Sky state strictly follow scene. Visible named cast: 왕먀오. Character sheets are identity references ONLY; never copy their backgrounds. Wang Miao always wears pale blue-grey shirt and dark trousers. All lettering and exact digits will be added later: NO readable text, numbers, symbols, balloons, captions or watermark in generated artwork. Clean coherent anatomy, strong ink composition, no extra characters or alien creatures. Non-graphic disaster where described.
